speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Coordinating Minister for Social Policies and Minister for Health whether subsidised patients can be transferred directly from a National Healthcare Group hospital to a SingHealth hospital without needing a new polyclinic referral to maintain their subsidies.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I was asking this question on behalf of a resident and members of the Breast Cancer Foundation.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I am not sure if what the Minister of State has just said is actually communicated and also practised on the ground.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: So, I will appreciate if that could be done, so that they have less concerns while already going through a lot of anxieties due to their medical conditions.
